name: Knight vs Monsters
detailed_description:
About This Game
In Knight vs Monsters, you play as a lone knight defending against 10 intense waves of enemy attacks. Armed with only your sword and shield, your mission is to survive each wave and defeat the growing number of monsters that emerge.

The combat system is wave-based: each wave brings more enemies than the last—not stronger or faster, just more of them. You'll need to time your attacks, move smartly, and stay alert as the battlefield becomes increasingly chaotic.

To help you stay alive, the game includes various power-ups that appear during gameplay. These boosters can restore your health, increase your movement speed, or enhance your attack rate—giving you an edge when you need it most.

Knight vs Monsters is a third-person action game focused on fast, fluid melee combat. There’s no complicated upgrade system or deep RPG mechanics—just pure sword-fighting fun in a medieval-inspired world. With responsive controls, stylized visuals, and wave-based survival gameplay, it offers a quick and thrilling combat experience.

Can you survive all 10 waves and prove yourself as the ultimate knight?
